blocks.content: Consistent revision of core concepts and rigorous practice of past papers are the cornerstones of competitive exam success.

items: Negative Marking Warning: Always eliminate options systematically rather than taking blind guesses.
Keyword Traps: Pay close attention to qualifying words like 'NOT correct', 'ONLY', 'ALWAYS', and 'EXCEPT' in multiple-choice questions.
Time Allocation: Stick strictly to designated time limits per question to ensure complete attempt of the question paper.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prioritize high-weightage topics during final revisions to maximize overall score.
Focus on direct facts, dates, constitutional amendments, and key definitions frequently asked in competitive exams.
Regularly practice previous year questions (PYQs) to identify recurring question patterns and common traps.
Maintain concise revision notes and formula sheets for rapid last-minute recall before the examination.
